content:
Emily (CS): Hey team :wave: kicking off orientation for Lumina Health (Mikaela). High-level goals: get API integrated, run a 2-week pilot, and validate latency/cost targets. Need to confirm stakeholders, success criteria, and a 3-week timeline. @Jon can you confirm seats and billing details?

Mikaela (Customer): Thanks, excited to start. Our top success criteria: 1) API integrated and called from prod-like env, 2) internal demo for product team, 3) latency under 300ms p50. Primary tech lead is me (Mikaela) and I'll loop in infra folks.

Jon (Sales): Contract is signed for 12 seats, billing set. I'll own renewal cadence. @Emily when do you want an exec check-in?

Priya (CSE): I'll take technical onboarding and integration support. Can we do an architecture review Wed 10am PT? I need request/traffic shape, example prompts, and a service account for testing.

Emily (CS): Wed 10am PT works for the team. I'll send the calendar invite. Draft onboarding checklist below — please flag missing items:
```
- Week 0: Orientation & architecture review
- Week 1: Integration sprint (API + auth + VPC if needed)
- Week 2: Internal demo & enablement training
- Week 3: Pilot metrics collection & review; decision point
```

Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a reference infra template (VPC peering + sample infra for Dedicated). Will have a repo PR by EOD Tue.

Mikaela (Customer): For metrics: we'll track latency p50/p95, error rate, and cost per 1k tokens. We'll share an anonymized sample traffic file by tomorrow.

Jon (Sales): Renewal risk: low. Flag if pilot retention < 30% or if latency > 400ms for >10% of calls.

Emily (CS): Action items captured:
- Emily: send invite + post notes
- Priya: architecture doc + test endpoints
- Marco: infra reference + repo PR
- Mikaela: sample traffic + list of internal stakeholders
Target dates: pilot start 2025-05-12, review 2025-06-02. :white_check_mark:

calendar-bot: Meeting created — "Lumina Orientation" Wed May 7 17:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.company/lumina-orientation

Priya (CSE): Acked. I'll also prepare a small debug harness for them. :eyes:

Emily (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the invite and a short success-criteria survey for the Lumina product team.

Mikaela (Customer): Appreciate it all, looking forward to the kickoff :heart:
